LightBox Individual Data Rights Request

Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) has become the industry shorthand for any request regarding personal information made by an individual exercising a consumer right provided by a privacy law. DSARs can include requests for a summary of personal data collected, requests to anonymize or delete personal data, or requests to correct incorrect personal data currently stored.
